g.text: The Land of the Rising Sun

text.tspan: Japan is an island nation in East Asia, located in
the Pacific Ocean. It comprises 14,125 islands,
with five main islands: Hokkaido, Honshu, Shikoku,
It seamlessly blends ancient traditions with
serene temples and traditional tea ceremonies to
Japan holds the world's fourth-largest economy by nominal GDP and is a global leader in technology, automotive manufacturing, and electronics.
Its cultural exports—from anime and film to cuisine and design—have a profound influence worldwide, making it a top destination for travelers and investors alike.

g.text: Note: Estimates based on registered foreigners.
Neon districts, world-class cuisine, tech innovation
Historic temples, traditional tea houses, bamboo groves
Street food, Osaka Castle, lively entertainment
Iconic volcano, onsen (hot springs), lake views
Ski slopes, national parks, fresh seafood
Each region offers a distinct slice of Japanese culture.
Sources: IMF WEO (Oct 2024), World Bank, Statistics Bureau of Japan. Figures are estimates and may vary.
